clips.title: The story
paras: Old Serra'kis is an ancient, massive threshadon dwelling in the submerged subterranean waters of Blackfathom Deeps. While the invading Twilight's Hammer culled much of the temple's aquatic life for provisions, this enormous beast proved entirely lethal to any who attempted to hunt it.

When the Twilight's Hammer cultists descended upon the sunken Moonshrine Ruins, they slaughtered the native wildlife beneath the waters for sustenance. Yet beneath the Moonshrine Sanctum, one primeval creature refused to become prey. Old Serra'kis, the largest threshadon in the sunken temple, made short work of any cultist brazen enough to spear him. Eventually, the hunters abandoned their efforts, leaving the ancient carnivore undisturbed in his watery domain.
